verses.text: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
And when the Pharisee saw it, he began to reason within himself, saying, Why washed he not first before dinner?
And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees, hypocrites, make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
Foolish ones, did not he that made the outside make the inside also?
But give as alms the things in your power; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.

section: Concerning the Pharisee Which Bade Him to Meat
